chunks: And from him, from several of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from al-Husayn ibn Sa'id, from Safwan, from Hammad ibn 'Uthman, who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about a person performing Hajj al-Mufrad (alone), whether he should hasten his Tawaf or delay it. He said, 'It is the same by Allah, whether he hastens it or delays it.'

key_terms.مُفْرِدٍ لِلْحَجِّ: Hajj al-Mufrad (a type of pilgrimage where one enters the state of Ihram solely for Hajj)

ai.seo_question: Is it mandatory to perform Tawaf immediately upon entering Mecca for Hajj al-Mufrad?
ai.summary: In this narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) clarifies the flexibility of Hajj al-Mufrad, affirming that the pilgrim may perform Tawaf al-Qudum either immediately upon arrival or later, as both timings are equally valid. This ruling underscores the ease (*yusr*) intended in Shia jurisprudence for individual pilgrims, distinguishing their practice from the more rigid requirements often associated with Hajj al-Qiran or Hajj al-Tamattu'.
